about_the_game:
Hello, investigator. Welcome to the demo of UFOPHILIA, a first-person psychological horror where you must detect, identify, and photograph alien lifeforms—while surviving their unpredictable behavior.

In this demo, you’ll get a taste of the full experience with access to a small tutorial mission and two complete real missions. During these, up to three different alien types may appear, each with its own unique behaviors and challenges. This is just the beginning: the full version will include nine alien species, seven missions, and many more surprises waiting to be uncovered.

Your task is simple in theory but terrifying in practice: explore, gather evidence, and capture the perfect photograph of your unearthly visitors. But remember—they are watching you too. Good luck hunting.

Demo Features

  • Tutorial Mission: Learn the basics of investigation, detection, and photography.

  • Two Real Missions: Experience the core gameplay loop with randomized alien encounters.

  • Three Alien Types: Each with distinct behaviors, from curious to aggressive.

  • Specialized Tools: Test some of the devices you’ll use in the full game, from EMF detectors to night vision cameras.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Tension-filled environments marked by alien activity.
